notes:
EDUCATION VOCABULARY:
{時間割|じかんわり} is the standard term for a school class schedule or timetable showing which subjects are taught when.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間割|じかんわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ - to create a schedule
- {時間割|じかんわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ - to change the schedule
- {時間割|じかんわり}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ - schedule chart/table
- ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時間割|じかんわり} - weekly schedule

SCHOOL CONTEXT:
Japanese schools typically post {時間割|じかんわり} in classrooms. Students learn to manage their materials based on their daily schedule.
